propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail with reducer-error, surfacing as INDETERMINATE on unrelated ticket reviews whose relation graph walks to that directory.
Plan reviews of tickets that do not reference an empty directory can fail if the relation snapshot walks the epic graph and encounters an event-less directory with no events to reduce.

An empty ticket directory created by a write that never completed its event emission is invisible to git (cannot be tracked) but persists in the local clone and causes deterministic plan-review failure until manually removed.
The plan-relation reducer should skip empty ticket directories with a named warning instead of failing the snapshot, allowing reviews to proceed and identifying the problematic path.

The writer should not be changed to clean up empty directories because cleanup cannot cover orphans from process death in the atomic write window and races concurrent writes, while only reader-side tolerance repairs existing broken clones.
